summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing an October 6, 2026 issuance of a $6.75 million senior secured convertible note to J.J. Astor Co. The note was issued under an amended and restated loan agreement and will fund in two tranches, with $3 million received on the first closing before fees. It matures March 24, 2027, payable in twenty-four weekly installments of $168,750 starting October 14, 2026, subject to increase upon a second tranche of $2 million that requires a resale registration statement, stockholder approval, no default, and a $3.00 minimum five-day closing bid price by December 31, 2026. The company also issued five-year warrants for 225,000 shares at $0.9177. The note is secured by a first-priority lien on all assets of the company and subsidiary guarantor. Eighty percent of post-October net proceeds from the existing at-the-market program with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners will be used to repay the note. This is a financing transaction, not a special situation under the defined categories. What to watch: second-tranche conditions and Nasdaq minimum bid compliance risk, which could trigger further dilution or defaults.
